reviews.title: Beware of fake profiles and coin traps
reviews.text:
This app is a total scam designed solely to drain your wallet.1-Monetized Everything: You are charged for virtually every basic interaction. Sending just a single message costs around 120 coins, and you are constantly pushed to spend real money on expensive virtual gifts.2-Fake Profiles & Catfishing: The app is flooded with fake accounts. Many of the profiles pretending to be women are actually men using stolen or fake photos to con users out of coins.3-Aggressive Automated Bots: As soon as you sign up, your inbox is instantly bombarded with messages from "women" eager to talk, purely to bait you into spending your money.4-Zero Verification: The developers make no effort to verify user profiles or curb fraud, clearly because they profit directly from these deceitful tactics.
Save your money and time—do not download this app.

reviews.title: Not good at all
reviews.text: I do not recommend this app based on my personal experience. My account was suspended for allegedly violating the platform's rules, but it was later restored without any explanation regarding the reason for the suspension or why it was reinstated. No compensation was offered for the inconvenience and stress caused, despite being a long-time player who had supported the platform for more than two years and spent a considerable amount of money on it. In addition, most chat features require payment, which may not be obvious to new users. Due to my dissatisfaction with the way my case was handled and my feeling that loyal users are not sufficiently appreciated, I lost confidence in the platform and decided to permanently delete my account. In my opinion, there are other platforms that provide better customer service and show greater appreciation for loyal users. Ahmad

reviews.title: BEWARE Scam!!
reviews.text: The app involves a mix of bots, fake profiles, and paid or automated accounts that are mainly used to encourage spending. It often charges coins for every message or interaction, and this system constantly pushes me toward making purchases, which makes the chats feel commercial or artificial rather than like genuine social interactions. Because these bots or fake accounts seem designed to drive engagement and coin spending, I personally see the app as a “scam” or “trap,” where most interaction feels artificial or financially motivated.
